dialogueItems.name: Nomsa
dialogueItems.text: You made it back in one piece! I did warn you they wouldn't be happy about it.

dialogueItems.name: Nomsa
dialogueItems.text: Electricity's fixed, pipe's fixed, and those freeloaders are disconnected. You've done so much to help me than I could have imagined.

dialogueItems.name: Nomsa
dialogueItems.text: I don't have much but here, take this.

dialogueItems.name: Nomsa
dialogueItems.text: I know it's not much, but it should cover the TV license at least. Wouldn't want the inspectors knocking on your door next.

dialogueItems.name: Nomsa
dialogueItems.text: There's a lot more with problems like me in the area, but hey, welcome to the neighbourhod!
